test: A4 production-DB acceptance audit of the sealed A3 run (94502b8): is the P14 -> P15 movement larger than what the 72-flop panel can resolve?
written: before any bootstrap replicate is solved
inputs: existing A3 artifacts only: per-flop solves k10..k14 (nodes 28, 6), loop_log accept/reject history, k9 / A1 start tables; no new postflop solve

method.panel_bootstrap: stratified resample of the 72 panel boards within strata (the panel's own sampling design, same as aggregate.py); ONE draw is applied to every step k10..k14 (the same 72 boards were used at every step, so their errors are coherent across steps)
method.replicate_tables: V_k(rep) = ht_rho estimate on the resampled boards for k = 10..14; the used chain is rebuilt with the recorded accept/reject flags: used_k = 0.5 V_k + 0.5 used_(k-1) if accepted else V_k; start tables used_9 fixed (node 28: k9/table.json; node 6: A1 table72, weight 0 because k10 was undamped)
method.preflop: one frozen-table preflop solve per replicate with {28: used_14(rep), 6: used_14(rep)} (t2_cont_terminal for nodes 6 and 28, same config/seeds/400 iterations as A3) -> replicate P15 main aggregates
method.validation: replicate 0 = identity draw must reproduce k14/used_node*.json (|d gross| <= 1e-9) and the A3 P15 main aggregates exactly; otherwise stop

variants.both: both terminals resampled with the same draw
variants.only28: node 28 resampled, node 6 at its A3 chain
variants.only6: node 6 resampled, node 28 at its A3 chain

method.main_aggregates: as convergence_rule.json: CO/BTN/SB first-in fold/raise/jam, BB vs BTN (node 28 parent) and BB vs SB (node 6 parent) fold/call/3bet/jam

quantities.h_a: 95% half-width of aggregate a across the 'both' replicates (percentile, (q97.5 - q2.5)/2)
quantities.amplitude: period-2 half-amplitude per aggregate over P12..P15: mean |P_k+1 - P_k| / 2

classification_fixed_before_results.precision_limited: not PASS, and every d_a <= h_a (the last step moves less than the panel's own 95% resolution), and max h_a > 0.005 (the 0.005 threshold is below the 72-flop resolution)
classification_fixed_before_results.per_terminal: the same comparison per terminal's aggregates (BB vs BTN with only28; SB first-in and BB vs SB with only6)

after_classification.true_not_converged: a new A4 continuation from P15, recorded separately from A3, warm-started from the A3 tables/caches
after_classification.precision_limited: no blind outer steps; targeted denser board panel for the terminal(s) that set the floor, reusing the existing 72 boards

not_done: no long solve before this audit is reported
